A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] '''Iktotchi [[Gender/Legends|female]]''' was a prophet with keen precognitive abilities who gathered a following on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] during the [[Great Peace of the Republic|First Century]] [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].

==Biography==
This prophet, who was native to the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], settled, around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[70 BBY/Legends|70 BBY]], on Saleucami, where she gathered a large following. She was sought out, without her knowledge, by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Venamis]], who kept her name on a list of potential [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentices]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis (novel)" />

Around the year [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], after Venamis was bested in a [[Contest on Sojourn|duel]] by the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], his list came to Plagueis's attention, who decided to seek out Venamis's candidates in order to determine if they would pose a threat to him and to the [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis (novel)" />

Plagueis traveled to Saleucami and came before the prophet among a large crowd. There, the Iktotchi apparently foretold major events of the coming half-century with great accuracy. She told of terrible [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|war]] fought between "[[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|machines of alloy]] and [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|machines of flesh]]" that would [[Clone Wars/Legends|cause]] the [[Declaration of a New Order|collapse]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|catastrophe]] for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and the formation of a [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] under "a [[Palpatine/Legends|ruthless despot]] who serves the forces of entropy." She preached a message of embracing the coming darkness as the only means of survival and called upon the audience members to approach her and be touched by her in order to be set upon the path towards their recreation.<ref name="Darth Plagueis (novel)" />

When Plagueis approached her, she took his hands in hers and immediately divined that he was a well-educated and wealthy Muun. She sensed that "he wore the darkness of the future" and claimed that he was the one she had sought out. Plagueis, gripping her hands tightly, told the prophet that she posed a threat to his cause, and struck her dead with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] through his grip. By killing her, the Dark Lord eliminated what he considered to be the preacher of an antiquated and dangerous message, the same message that had doomed the Sith of old, and a threat to the inevitable future.<ref name="Darth Plagueis (novel)" />

==Legacy==
After her murder at Plagueis' hands, the prophet's visions of the future came to pass: in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Clone Wars split the Republic,<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> and [[19 BBY/Legends|three years later]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Darth Plagueis's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], reformed the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> and subjugated countless species and worlds.
